name: @requestly/cross-q-context
description: cross-q-context — the API-client scripting core. This build ships the transform pillar: rewrite every script dialect (Postman pm.*/postman.*, Bruno bru.*) to the rq.* API (OXC-based Rust → WebAssembly, strings in / typed objects out). The execute pillar (the safe QuickJS engine) is the app's quickjs-emscripten runtime, absorbed here as JS — not a separate Rust runtime.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-transform --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q-context/engine --out-name cross_q_context && wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-transform --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q-context/engine-node --out-name cross_q_context
